passes.postPasses.description: Creates a pass from a template. `input` holds the template's fields; see `sample` on the template. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely. Set `sendEmail` with `holderEmail` to email the pass.

passes.getPassesById.description: One pass with its fields, links and channels.

passes.getPasses.description: Lists passes, newest first. Filter by template, status, holder email, `externalId` or inputs with `match`; page with `cursor`. `count=true` adds the number of matches.

passes.patchPassesById.description: Changes a pass's fields. Send `If-Match` with the current `version`; a stale version is `412 VERSION_CONFLICT`. Installed passes update in Wallet.

passes.postPassesByIdVoid.description: Voids a pass. Wallet shows it as void and scans are refused. Undo with unvoid.

passes.postPassesByIdRemove.description: Removes the pass from Wallet by publishing a voided, expired final version. The record stays; undo with restore. `message` shows on the lock screen.

request.message: Your day pass was replaced by a monthly membership.

passes.postPassesByIdRestore.description: Undoes a removal and publishes the pass again.

passes.deletePassesById.description: Deletes the pass record. To take a pass out of Wallet and keep the record, use remove.

passes.postPassesByIdResendEmail.description: Emails the pass link to the holder, or to `to` when given. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely.

passes.postPassesByIdRotateLink.description: Replaces the download and public links. The old links stop working.

passes.postPassesByIdNewCode.description: Mints a new scan code. The old code stops working.

passes.getPassesViews.description: The saved views of the passes list.

passes.putPassesViews.description: Replaces the saved views (at most 20) of an organization and mode. Send the `revision` you read; a stale one answers 409 `VIEWS_CHANGED`. A view cannot hold a holder email.

passes.postPassesBulkRuns.description: Voids, emails or removes every pass a filter matches, in the background. The matching passes are fixed when the run starts; `expectCount` must equal the count then, or it answers 409 `SELECTION_CHANGED`. One run at a time per organization and mode.

request.message: Your day pass was replaced by a monthly membership.

passes.getPassesBulkRunsById.description: The progress of a bulk run.

passes.postPassesBulkRunsByIdStop.description: Stops a running bulk run after its current chunk. Passes already handled stay handled.

passes.getPassesBulkRunsCurrent.description: The organization's running bulk run, or the last one that ended within the hour; run is absent when there is none.

passes.postPassesBulk.description: Voids, emails or removes up to 100 passes: send `ids`, or a `selection` with a filter and the `expectCount` you saw (any other count answers 409 SELECTION_CHANGED). Above 100 passes use POST /passes/bulk-runs.

passes.putPassesByIdConnection.description: Binds a pass to a connection ref, or unbinds it. A bound pass takes its fields from the connection.

passes.postPassesByIdRefresh.description: Rebuilds the pass from its connection and pushes the change to devices.

passes.getPassesByIdVersionsByVersion.description: A retained version of a pass, for rendering.

passes.getPassesByIdDiff.description: The fields that differ between two retained versions of a pass.

passes.getPassesByIdAssets.description: The per-pass image overrides of a pass.

passes.putPassesByIdAssetsByName.description: Uploads an image override for one pass as a PNG body.

passes.deletePassesByIdAssetsByName.description: Removes an image override. The pass goes back to the template's image.

passes.getPassesByIdMemberPhoto.description: The member photo settings of a pass.

passes.putPassesByIdMemberPhoto.description: Uploads a member photo for a pass.

passes.patchPassesByIdMemberPhoto.description: Sets whether the photo is included in the Wallet pass.

passes.getPassesByIdMemberPhotoImage.description: The member photo bytes. The photo is private and needs a key with access to the pass.

passes.postPassesPhotosMatch.description: Matches photo file names to passes by external ID or serial. It reads names only and changes nothing.

passes.getPassesByIdCheckIn.description: The check-in rules of a pass.

passes.putPassesByIdCheckIn.description: Sets the check-in rules of a pass.

passes.postPassesByIdStamps.description: Adds stamps to a stamp card, or redeems its reward.

passes.postPassesByIdRenew.description: Renews the term of a pass.

passes.postPassesBulkReissue.description: Rebuilds the passes of a template in your org and pushes them to devices. A key needs `passes:write`.

passes.postPassesBulkChannels.description: Turns channels on, off or back to the template for up to 100 passes in one call.

passes.getPassesByIdChannels.description: A pass's channels: effective state, source and overrides.

passes.putPassesByIdChannels.description: Overrides channels for one pass. A `null` value returns that channel to its template.

passes.postPassesBulkPrint.description: Prints up to 50 passes of one org into one PDF. A job renders it; poll the job.

skipped.reason: Paper is off for Quickstart ticket

passes.getPassesBulkPrintByJobId.description: The state of a bulk print job.

passes.getPassesBulkPrintByJobIdPdf.description: The combined PDF of a finished bulk print job.

passes.postPassesByIdPrints.description: Prints a ticket. An earlier print of the same pass is voided.

passes.getPassesByIdPrints.description: A pass's prints, newest first. Codes are never listed.

passes.postPassesByIdPrintsByPrintIdVoid.description: Voids a printed ticket so its code stops working.

passes.getPassesByIdPrint.description: The print page of the active print, for staff.

passes.getPassesByIdPrintPdf.description: The PDF of the active print, for staff.

passes.getPassesByIdPrintAssetsByName.description: A template image used by the print page, for staff.

passes.getPassesByIdEvents.description: The sync log and activity of a pass, newest first.

passes.getPassesByIdDevices.description: The devices of a pass with their sync status.

passes.postPassesByIdPrintDrawn.description: Records that the active print was drawn again from the pass as it is now, so it is no longer stale.
